about.title: Hi, I'm Joanna.
about.lead: I help leaders find the words for the work they already do — and build the rooms where those words land.
about.body: I've spent two decades on stages and in private rooms with founders, executives, and women rebuilding their voice after the company they built outgrew the person they used to be. What I teach isn't speaking. It's the moment — the one that shaped what you actually know, and how to say it so people trust you immediately.
about.quote: Influence is not a volume problem. It's a clarity problem.

timeline.text: First stage. Terrified. Discovered story-mining by accident.
Started coaching one woman in a café. Then a hundred.
First True Influence retreat — 8 women, one room, real results.
The method became the curriculum. 300+ leaders guided.

journey.title: How I found the work.
journey.lead: The short version. The longer one I tell on stage.

chapters.text: I was good at speaking. I was bad at being heard. There is a difference and it cost me a decade.
A woman across a café asked me one question. I told her a story I had never said out loud. She cried. So did I. That was the moment I knew what I actually do.

Eight women, four days, one room. No slides. No framework. Just the moment each of them had been talking around for years. They left with a voice the room could feel. I have been running the method ever since.
Hundreds of leaders. Stages, boardrooms, kitchens at 11pm. The work is the same. The story behind your solution is the only thing that makes you trusted.
You. Whatever moment you have been talking around — let us name it.

journey.closerQuote: Influence is not a volume problem. It is a clarity problem.

stories.title: The receipts.
stories.lead: Real women, real results — across every phase of the method.

items.name: Victoria Richardson
items.body: I know Joanna's helped me with some of my speeches. I had a conference a couple like a year and a half ago, and she helped me kind of build the presentation."“I now feel inspired and more clear in my why and my purpose.

items.name: LeQuisha Underwood
items.quote: Got the board to listen, finally.
items.body: Biggest change in me is confidence. I found the part of me that is willing to tell it. And I've told Joanna, she's my changing myself into the wind. So, this is like taking off. It's like taking flight. I am so happy I did this. I found the part of me that is willing to tell it. That's what—I'm going to tell it from the place I am now.

items.name: Kendi Brown
items.body: I've worked with Joanna to really understand what made me unique in the world of business. I felt really lost about what I could actually talk about and Joanna was able to help me go through several breakthroughs to be able to put together a talk that I feel will be able to impact someone's life.

items.name: Dawn Armstrong
items.quote: Paid for itself in one introduction.
items.body: Joanna keeps saying it's a process and she's she's absolutely right. You have to believe in the process and make it happen. Joanna's superpower, I think, is giving people the confidence they didn't know they had and encouraging them to go deeper than they want to go safely because that's hard.

items.name: Jessica Avignone
items.body: My message was a little disjointed. And with working with Joanna, what happened was you get real laser-focused and you—I mean, you've got seven minutes and you got a lot you want to say, so you better be very clear and deliver it confidently.

items.name: Monica May Dunn
items.quote: The clearest yes I have ever given myself.
items.body: I think everybody could use Joanna's services because even if you do public speaking already, just having the guidance and the structure on what people want to know, what points you really need to make and to stand out because I want to stand out and not that I want to be better, but I want my message to really hit home to a lot of people.
